# find_all_pbc_wrap_marker_pairs { #mofography.widest_path_resegment.find_all_pbc_wrap_marker_pairs }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-experimental">experimental</span> Enumerate leaky in-cell plus wrapped marker pairs at maxima.

```python
widest_path_resegment.find_all_pbc_wrap_marker_pairs(
    maxima_info,
    pbc_groups=None,
)
```

All in-cell + single-axis wrapped label pairs at each maxima position.

Pairs are found by shared unit-cell image coordinates ``row[1:4]``, not only
``pbc_groups`` membership (a-axis wraps like label 17 may sit outside the group).
